title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Sorted Cells
author: Raining Wang
materials: Prepare a lysis master mix of the following reagents and mix by vortexing briefly:

steps.title: Aliquot master mix
steps.instruction: Aliquot 322 µL of the master mix into each labeled 1.7‑mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend each cell pellet in DPBS at 100 µL per 5 × 10⁶ cells (e.g., 200 µL for 10 × 10⁶ cells) and, if the volume exceeds 100 µL, split the suspension into two separate tubes.

steps.title: Add cells to lysis mix
steps.instruction: Add the 100 µL DPBS‑resuspended cells to the corresponding tube containing the lysis master mix and vortex to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 56 °C with agitation at 1500 rpm for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a labeled DNeasy mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute; discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute; discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 3 minutes; discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Dry spin column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 20 000 × g for 1 minute to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Elute DNA – first water addition
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a labeled 1.7‑mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL molecular‑grade water, incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, then centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA – second water addition
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with an additional 100 µL molecular‑grade water and centrifuge at 6000 × g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect split eluates
steps.instruction: If the original pellet was split (more than 5 × 10⁶ cells), transfer each eluate into labeled 2.0‑mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Quantify and store DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and store the samples at –20 °C.
